verdict.rationale: Bolna's own agent analytics tab documents configuring webhooks that push per-call data outward ('Push data to your CRM from every call'), so it has a first-party outbound webhook capability. The evidence is a single summary line, though, and does not detail what can be subscribed to or how delivery works. Missing for 10: documented event types/subscription model, payload schema, registration via API, delivery/retry and signing details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI. Push data to your CRM from every call.
